result:
Clean typecheck and all 617 existing tests pass, plus my scratch verification confirmed the new behavior (sub-issue listing, roll-up, cycle/depth rejection, archive cascade, and the completion notice) works end-to-end before I removed the throwaway test.

Summary of changes implementing sub-issues:
- **`src/config/constants.ts`**: added `MAX_SUB_ISSUE_DEPTH`.
- **`src/lib/issue-hierarchy.ts`** (new): `IssueHierarchyError` with `"cycle" | "too_deep"` reasons.
- **`src/lib/errors.ts`**: maps `IssueHierarchyError` to `conflict` and recognizes it in `isDomainError`.
- **`src/types/issue.ts`**: added `IssueRollup`.
- **`src/types/notification.ts`**, **`src/schemas/notification.ts`**, **`src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts`**, **`notification-preferences-form.tsx`**: added the `sub_issues_completed` kind everywhere kinds are enumerated.
- **`src/schemas/issue.ts`**: added `setIssueParentSchema`/`SetIssueParentInput`.
- **`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`**: added `setIssueParent`, `listSubIssues`, `listIssuesForProject`, `listLiveDescendants`, `archiveIssuesByIds`.
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`**: `createIssue` now validates a given `parentId` (live issue, same project); `archiveIssue` cascades to live descendants at any depth, emitting one `issue.archived` per descendant; added `setIssueParent` (cycle/depth guarded via in-memory tree walk), `listSubIssues`, `getIssueRollup`.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`**: subscribes to `issue.status_changed`/`issue.archived` to notify a parent's assignee once when its last open sub-issue closes (direct parent only, skipped when archived/unassigned, routed through the normal fan-out so self-notifications and preferences are respected).

No existing tests encoded behavior this change alters, so none needed updating.
